verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a financial-services API platform like Paxos, but the evidence pack documents no retention policies, data deletion requests, or user data purge capability. The only related item is the Delete Fiat Account endpoint, which stops future transfers to a bank account. That is a resource-management control, not control over how long data is kept or whether it is erased, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
